name: Hotpoint HDM67G0C2CB — Gas (NG) Freestanding Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Hotpoint HDM67G0C2CB is a 60cm double-oven gas cooker in black with two fan ovens (up to 84L of space, six shelf levels). Its four-burner gas hob includes a Triple Crown wok burner that cooks up to 15% faster, with 10-level flame control and a flame-failure safety device. Catalytic liners keep cleaning easy. A+ energy rated.
